title: Remove a milk carton pull-ring inner seal cleanly
instruction: With the outer cap already off, use the left hand and the clean hook to lift the flat pull ring without tearing the inner seal. Grasp the raised ring directly with the right gripper, withdraw the hook and place it back on its clean rest. Grip the middle of the carton top seam with the left gripper, pull the complete seal out with the right gripper and release it in the discard tray. Keep the carton upright and the pouring mouth clean, leave the cap untouched, and avoid spilling milk.
context: The robot opens a molded food-package seal that lies flat inside a narrow spout. It must steady a full carton during the pull and carry the removed seal clear of the pouring mouth.
setup: Nominal simulation: filled 1.89 L gable-top paperboard milk carton, 102 × 102 × 258 mm including its top seam, 2.02 kg total; 32 mm mouth bore tilted 45 degrees, flat molded plastic ring with 20 mm inner diameter, intact 1 mm membrane. Reference product: LACTAID Whole Milk 64 fl oz, UPC 041383090363 (Target product 13292765). Actual closure dimensions and forces are unmeasured. Carton center x=395, y=35 mm on the worktop. A proposed 45 g open steel lifting hook has a 44 × 16 × 18 mm acetal grip offset by 65 mm along y from the toe. At reset the grip centre is x=255, y=180 mm on clean posts and the toe is at x=265, y=115 mm, approximately 13 mm above the worktop; the 200 × 120 × 22 mm plastic discard tray is centered at x=455, y=−180 mm. The removed white cap is face up on an 80 × 80 × 4 mm clean polymer rest centered at x=240, y=−300 mm. Coordinates and geometry are defined in task.py; tool fabrication details are in tool_build/. The work surface is the inside floor of a removable, liquid-tight pan with a 600 × 800 mm clear footprint and a 40 mm minimum rim. Three sides extend to 160 mm as splash guards. Both grippers use fitted washable waterproof covers from fingertips to wrist. See wet-trial.md for fit, capacity and commissioning checks. A closed 550 mm clear hood with gasketed seams and two sealed rolling arm sleeves keeps the robot bases, cabling and uncovered mechanisms on the dry side. Nest the wet enclosure in its own seamless 680 × 880 × 30 mm secondary pan, extending 40 mm from each primary inner edge (37 mm clear beyond each 3 mm wall). The shared robot bases and wiring are beyond the outer rim.
scoring: The untouched setup scores 0. Credit requires a hook-assisted lift of at least 30 degrees, both right fingertips holding the ring independently of the hook for at least two control steps while the left hand still supports the raised ring with the hook and the seal is intact, and withdrawal and release of the hook on its clean rest. The right gripper must pull the ring directly while both left fingertips contact opposite exterior sides of the folded top within 12 mm of the seam midpoint. All opening credit requires the inner seal to have torn free from its seat. Award 0.35 when at least 25% of the mouth is unobstructed; 0.70 when the entire seal is outside the mouth and at least 98% is unobstructed. Score 1.0 after the complete seal is inside and supported by the tray (directly), moving no faster than 10 mm/s, both grippers have released the objects, the carton is supported and within 5 degrees of upright, and the untouched cap remains face up on its clean rest, continuously for 1 s. Unbraced opening under load, arm collision, specified contamination, a seal penetrating past the inside end of the spout, or accumulated spill above 1 mL makes the trial score 0 permanently. Missing required native observations prevent credit.
reset_notes: Use a new factory-sealed carton for each real trial. The reset operator removes only the outer cap without touching its inside or the pouring mouth, places it face up on the clean rest, and verifies the inner ring/seal is intact and flat. Clean and dry the tool, grippers, rests and tray. Do not manually reattach an opened inner seal. Run each simulation trial in a fresh process. Hold unopened cartons at 1–4 °C. Run in a 20–22 °C room with milk at 1–4 °C at the start and finish. Allow at most 10 minutes from refrigerator removal to the end of the trial, including setup and pauses. Verify and record temperature as specified in wet-trial.md. Discard each trial carton.
fidelity: Rigid carton, hinged ring and rigid seal. The bond releases at 24 N outward native contact force over two 240 Hz substeps, based on a related molded fitment. The carton carries 98% of milk inertia; volume-tracking particles carry 2%. This approximates upright opening with small spills. Membrane stretching, ring-post fracture, large-pour momentum and tool yielding are unresolved. The reference carton has no measured pull-force curve. The pan walls collide in Isaac. The pan bottom shares the calibrated worktop collision plane. The protected grippers use the nominal fitted outer contact envelope. Boot leakage, pad friction when wet and product temperature require bench checks. Hood panels and the liquid boundaries of both sleeves collide with particles. Sleeve deformation, seam leakage, and splash droplets below particle resolution require the four-direction water test before physical use.
tool_rest: A 140 × 110 × 0.5 mm polymer base supports two 7 × 18 × 35.5 mm posts, 32 mm apart along x.
scripted_brace: During tear-out, both left fingertips hold opposite sides of the folded top within 12 mm of its midpoint while both right fingertips contact the ring.
